literal: On jiawu day, dispatched Southern Court linya Gaojianu and others to convey the edict and offer reassurance.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Southern Court linya Gaojianu and others were dispatched to convey the edict and offer reassurance.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingshen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
idiomatic: On the bingshen new moon of the tenth winter month there was a solar eclipse.

literal: Eleventh month, on xinmao day, edict ordered that when officials of all posts received successors by ritual or left office for crimes, registers were to be kept and reported yearly to the Privy Council.
idiomatic: On xinmao day of the eleventh month an edict ordered that when officials of all posts received successors by ritual or left office for crimes, registers were to be kept and reported yearly to the Privy Council.

literal: Twelfth month, on bingchen new moon, edict ordered Uighur tribal deputy commissioners to be filled by Khitan persons.
idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the twelfth month an edict ordered Uighur tribal deputy commissioners to be filled by Khitan persons.

literal: On gengzi day, the Responding Sage Festival; partial amnesty for offenses at or below convict labor.
idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Responding Sage Festival, a partial amnesty was granted for offenses at or below convict labor.

literal: On renzi day, edict to great ministers said: "I and the Song ruler are pledged as brothers; our friendship has lasted many years. I wish to see his painted likeness; you may instruct the incoming envoys."
idiomatic: On renzi day an edict to great ministers said: "I and the Song ruler are pledged as brothers; our friendship has lasted many years. I wish to see his painted likeness; you may instruct the incoming envoys."

literal: In the twenty-third year, spring, first month, on jisi day, went to the Huntong River.
idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, on jisi day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

literal: On guiyou day, hunted at Shuangzi Marsh.
idiomatic: On guiyou day the court hunted at Shuangzi Marsh.

literal: On wuzi day, Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute goods.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Xia State sent envoys with tribute goods.

literal: On renchen day, went to spring waters.
idiomatic: On renchen day the court went to spring waters.

literal: On jiawu day, hunted at Panzhipo.
idiomatic: On jiawu day the court hunted at Panzhipo.

literal: Third month, on dinghai day, visited the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan's tent.
idiomatic: On dinghai day of the third month the court visited the Emperor's younger brother Chongyuan's tent.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on guimao day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the fourth summer month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On guichou day, hunted at Hezhihuli.
idiomatic: On guichou day the court hunted at Hezhihuli.

literal: Fifth month, on jisi day, Li Liangzuo begged to present horses and camels; edict ordered yearly tribute.
idiomatic: On jisi day of the fifth month Li Liangzuo begged to present horses and camels; an edict ordered yearly tribute.

literal: On gengyin day, halted at Yongan Mountain.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the court halted at Yongan Mountain.

literal: On renchen day, Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On renchen day Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Sixth month, on bingshen day, went to Qing Prefecture.
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the sixth month the court went to Qing Prefecture.

literal: On yihai day, paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On yihai day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: On renyin day, Goryeo king Hui requested official rank for his son; edict ordered promotion to acting Grand Master of War.
idiomatic: On renyin day Goryeo king Hui requested official rank for his son; an edict ordered promotion to acting Grand Master of War.

literal: On xinhai day, Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jisi day, Xia State Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys to seek marriage.
idiomatic: On jisi day of the seventh autumn month Xia State Li Liangzuo sent envoys to seek marriage.

literal: On jiaxu day, went to autumn mountains.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day the court went to autumn mountains.

literal: On jimao day, edict ordered the eight house-clans to wear headcloths.
idiomatic: On jimao day an edict ordered the eight house-clans to wear headcloths.

literal: Ninth month, on gengyin day, hunted; encountering three tigers, released dogs and captured them.
idiomatic: On gengyin day of the ninth month the court hunted; encountering three tigers, dogs were released and they were captured.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingyou day, halted at the Central Capital.
idiomatic: On dingyou day of the tenth winter month the court halted at the Central Capital.

literal: On wuxu day, visited the newly built Directorate of the Imperial Library.
idiomatic: On wuxu day the court visited the newly built Directorate of the Imperial Library.

literal: On xinchou day, performed rites at the ancestral temple.
idiomatic: On xinchou day rites were performed at the ancestral temple.

literal: On guichou day, because silver Buddha images were cast at Kaitai Temple, a partial amnesty for prisoners in the capital.
idiomatic: On guichou day, because silver Buddha images were cast at Kaitai Temple, a partial amnesty was granted for prisoners in the capital.

literal: On bingchen day, Li Liangzuo dispatched envoys presenting an oath memorial.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Li Liangzuo sent envoys presenting an oath memorial.

literal: Eleventh month, on yichou day, Zubu tribal chiefs came with tribute.
idiomatic: On yichou day of the eleventh month Zubu tribal chiefs came with tribute.

literal: On renshen day, the Emperor led the ministers in presenting the Empress Dowager the honorific title Benevolent, Sagely, Pious, Filial, Broadly Virtuous, Tranquil, Pure, Gracious, Harmonious, Generous, Reverent, Awakened, Ceremonious, Heavenly Empress Dowager, and proclaimed a great amnesty.
idiomatic: On renshen day the Emperor led the ministers in presenting the Empress Dowager the honorific title Benevolent, Sagely, Pious, Filial, Broadly Virtuous, Tranquil, Pure, Gracious, Harmonious, Generous, Reverent, Awakened, Ceremonious, Heavenly Empress Dowager, and proclaimed a great amnesty.

literal: Inner and outer officials advanced in rank by degree.
idiomatic: Inner and outer officials advanced in rank by degree.

literal: On guimao day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On guimao day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: On jiashen day, the ministers presented the Emperor the honorific title Revering Heaven, Upholding the Way, Protecting the Age, Raising the Calendar, Martially Settling, Literaryly Accomplished, Sagely, Spiritually Benevolent, Filial Emperor, and invested Empress Xiao with the title Chaste, Gracious, Kind, Harmonious, Cultured, Favorable, Reverent, Filial, Broadly Loving, Chong, Sagely Empress.
idiomatic: On jiashen day the ministers presented the Emperor the honorific title Revering Heaven, Upholding the Way, Protecting the Age, Raising the Calendar, Martially Settling, Literaryly Accomplished, Sagely, Spiritually Benevolent, Filial Emperor, and invested Empress Xiao with the title Chaste, Gracious, Kind, Harmonious, Cultured, Favorable, Reverent, Filial, Broadly Loving, Chong, Sagely Empress.

literal: Twelfth month, on bingshen day, went to Zhonghuichuan.
idiomatic: On bingshen day of the twelfth month the court went to Zhonghuichuan.
